ambient_events: The old cistern holds its silence like water, deep and total.
Your smallest movement sends a ring of echo around the round brick wall.
Something valuable-looking has fetched up on the shelf of silt — or something that only looks it.
description: A walled-off Victorian cistern, round and domed and dry-ish, cut off from the main flow when the newer lines were bored. The current that used to feed it now only leaks, so it has become a settling pool for a century of things carried this deep and abandoned. A rich, quiet dead end for anyone willing to dig.
name: Old Cistern
